title: Whose Truth? Pluralistic Geo-Alignment for (Agentic) AI
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not present a benchmark and does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It proposes a framework for 'geo-alignment' to align AI with geographically varying societal norms, values, and goals, but does not use religion as an example or dimension of analysis.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the research. The focus is on the geographic variability of AI alignment.
